Shahad yarinya ce ta kirki, amma kullum tana tafiya fuskarta a murtuke, kamar akwai wani kaya mai nauyi a kafaɗunta.

Kawarta Dana kuma idan ta haɗu da kowa takan yi masa murmushi, ƙarami ne ko babba.

Da safe suka hau bas, sai Dana ta ce wa direba: "Barka da safiya, Baba Jamil" tana murmushi.

Sai Baba Jamil ya yi murmushi ya ce: "Barka kadai, 'yata." Amma Shahad ta zauna ba ta kalle shi ba.

A makaranta suka wuce Inna Ummu Sa'id, tana share fili tun alfijir.

Sai Dana ta ce mata: "Allah Ya saka miki da alheri, Inna, filin ya yi kyau." Sai Ummu Sa'id ta ɗaga kanta, gajiyar da ke fuskarta ta fara narkewa.

Sai Shahad ta ce wa Dana: "Me ya sa kike yi wa kowa murmushi? Ba ki san su ba."

Sai Dana ta ce: "Manzon Allah ﷺ ya ce: Murmushinka a fuskar ɗan'uwanka sadaka ce a gare ka. Kuma sadaka ce da ba ta kashe mini komai."

Sai Shahad ta ce: "Sadaka? Ba tare da kuɗi ba?" Dana ta ce: "Ki jarraba rana ɗaya kawai."

Sai Shahad ta yi shiru, ba ta ce eh ba, ba ta ce a'a ba.

Washegari Shahad ta hau bas, ta so ta ce barka da safiya, sai kalmar ta fito a ƙasa-ƙasa, murmushin kuma ƙarami.

Sai Baba Jamil ya ce: "Barka kadai, Shahad! Wannan ne karo na farko da na ga murmushinki."

Sannan ta wuce Inna Ummu Sa'id, ta ce mata: "Assalamu alaikum, Inna." Sai Ummu Sa'id ta amsa sallamar tana farin ciki, ta ce: "Barka da zuwa, 'yata."

Sai Shahad ta ji wani abu mai sauƙi a ƙirjinta.

A lokacin hutu wata sabuwar yarinya ta zo tana tsaye ita kaɗai, ba ta san kowa ba.

Sai Shahad ta tafi wurinta, ta yi mata murmushi, ta ce: "Zo mu tafi tare."

Da Shahad ta koma gida, ta ce wa mahaifiyarta: "Yau na yi murmushi sau biyar, sai mutane biyar suka yi mini murmushi."

Sannan ta yi dariya ta ce: "Kuma Dana tana yin haka kowace rana!"

Tun daga wannan rana Baba Jamil ya fara cewa: "Yanzu murmushi biyu ne a cikin bas ɗina."

Manzon Allah ﷺ ya ce: "Murmushinka a fuskar ɗan'uwanka sadaka ce a gare ka."

📖 Tirmizi ne ya ruwaito shi. Wannan labari ne na misali, bai faru da wani mutum na musamman ba.
